Before sending updates, publishing notes, purchasing, paying or deleting anything.
When incident or change records are unavailable or stale: it marks missing evidence and leaves the cause unresolved.
When the incident does not match the named service: it does no incident work.

Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production.

items.title_ja: 見積もりと契約更新の準備担当Bot
items.does: Prepares purchase comparisons and renewal decisions from current quotes, with expiry dates and open questions. Stops before contacting vendors; never buys, renews, cancels or pays.
items.does_ja: 現在の見積もりをもとに購入や契約更新の比較資料を作り、有効期限と未解決の質問を整理します。取引先への連絡前に止まり、購入・更新・解約・支払いは行いません。
stops: Before buying, renewing, cancelling or paying: these actions remain yours.
Before contacting vendors, sending requests, publishing comparisons, deleting records or changing production: it asks first.
When a quote expires or its scope differs from the request: it holds that option for clarification.
When current prices or renewal terms are unavailable: it marks them unknown rather than using remembered figures.
first3: Fill the blanks with the purchase scope, decision criteria, quote sources and renewal register.
Paste the first message into a new Bot and ask it to remember the preparation rules.
Ask for one purchase comparison; check quote dates, missing costs and decision status against the sources.

blanks.name: [PURCHASE_SCOPE]
blanks.what: The goods, services or purchase requests this Bot should prepare.

blanks.name: [BUYING_CRITERIA]
blanks.what: Your required quantity, acceptable terms, budget and decision priorities.

blanks.name: [QUOTE_SOURCES]
blanks.what: Named connected apps or supplied files containing quotes and current prices.

blanks.name: [RENEWAL_REGISTER]
blanks.what: The renewal list and agreement records to read, or none if there are no renewals.

items.title: Release desk, preparation notes only
items.title_ja: リリース準備メモ担当Bot
items.does: Sets up a Bot to draft release changes, risks and a checklist from repository records. It stops at preparation notes and never tags, deploys or merges.
items.does_ja: リポジトリの記録から変更点・リスク・確認項目をまとめるBotへの依頼文です。準備メモの作成までで止まり、タグの作成・デプロイ・マージはしません。
stops: Before tagging, deploying or merging: it returns preparation notes only.
Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production.
Before changing repository access or expanding the release range: it asks first.
When the release range, guide or records are missing or stale: it reports the affected gaps.
first3: Create a Bot with the + at the top of the sidebar and give it release preparation as its one job.
Fill the blanks and send the message with read access to the named repository and release guide.
Request notes for a small release range and compare the changes, risks and checklist with the source records.

blanks.name: [REPOSITORY]
blanks.what: The connected repository app and the repository the Bot may read.

blanks.name: [RELEASE_RANGE]
blanks.what: The start and end revisions or the explicit set of changes to include.

blanks.name: [RELEASE_GUIDE]
blanks.what: The source document containing the team's release steps and readiness criteria.

blanks.name: [NOTE_FORMAT]
blanks.what: The headings and length for the release preparation notes.

items.title: Research desk, briefs with sources
items.title_ja: 出典を添える調査担当Bot
items.does: Sets up a Bot to compare sources, draft research briefs and mark unsupported claims as unverified. It stops at a brief in chat and never publishes.
items.does_ja: 出典を照合して調査メモを作り、根拠が足りない主張に未確認の印を付けるBotへの依頼文です。チャット内のメモ作成までで止まり、公開はしません。
stops: Before sending or publishing: the brief stays in this chat.
Before purchasing access, paying, deleting material or changing production.
Before adding sources or changing access: it asks first.
When evidence is missing, stale or conflicting: it marks the claim unverified and explains the gap.
first3: Create a Bot with the + at the top of the sidebar and give it the research job.
Fill the blanks, send this first message and ask the Bot to remember its rules.
Request one brief on a narrow question and compare each main claim with its cited source.

blanks.name: [RESEARCH_SCOPE]
blanks.what: The question to research and the subjects to leave out.

blanks.name: [SOURCES]
blanks.what: The connected apps and source collections the Bot may read.

blanks.name: [AS_OF]
blanks.what: The date the brief should describe and the acceptable age of its sources.

blanks.name: [BRIEF_FORMAT]
blanks.what: The desired headings and length of the research brief.

items.title: Team intake desk, records and routing notes
items.title_ja: チームの依頼を記録して担当候補を整理するBot
items.does: Records team requests with proposed owners or queues and missing information. It stops before contacting owners, changing assignments or doing the requested work.
items.does_ja: チームの依頼を、担当者や窓口の候補、不足情報とともに記録します。担当者への連絡、割り当ての変更、依頼内容の実行の前で止まります。
stops: Before contacting proposed owners or changing assignments elsewhere: routing stays in the intake ledger.
Before executing a request: recording it never authorizes the work.
Before sending, publishing content or the Bot, purchasing, paying, deleting, changing production or adding shared access: it asks first.
Before adopting a Collaborator teaching: the owner or a Manager must approve the suggestion.
When source records or routing rules are missing, stale or contradictory: affected entries stay pending.
first3: Fill the blanks and have the owner or a Manager put the short description under About in the Team Bot details.
Add the listed setup materials only after checking that everyone who chats with the Bot may use them, then send the first message.
Try a small request set and inspect the ledger, proposed routing and missing details before relying on the intake rules.

blanks.name: [REQUEST_SCOPE]
blanks.what: The kinds of team requests this Bot accepts for intake.

blanks.name: [INTAKE_RULES]
blanks.what: Required request details and rules for recording incomplete or duplicate requests.

blanks.name: [ROUTING_MAP]
blanks.what: The current mapping from request types to proposed owners or queues.

blanks.name: [REQUEST_SOURCES]
blanks.what: Shared apps and request sources that all Bot users may access.

blanks.name: [SHARED_SKILLS]
blanks.what: Intake skills suitable for everyone using this Team Bot.

blanks.name: [SHARED_FILES]
blanks.what: Shared files containing the current intake rules and routing map.

items.title: Team support desk, drafts only
items.title_ja: チームの問い合わせ仕分けと返信下書き
items.does: Sets one shared support job, lists what teammates can access, and prepares triage notes and reply drafts. It stops before sending, closing tickets or publishing the Bot.
items.does_ja: 共有する問い合わせ対応の役割と、チームが利用する情報を決め、仕分け結果と返信下書きを作ります。送信、問い合わせの完了処理、Botの公開前に止まります。
stops: Before sending replies, closing tickets or changing their assignment: show the proposed action and ask first.
Before publishing content or the Bot, or adding shared access: show what everyone who chats with it will share and ask first.
Before purchasing, paying, deleting records or changing production: stop and ask first.
When source records or support rules are missing or stale: mark the affected draft as blocked.
first3: On a Team or Enterprise plan, fill the blanks and put the short description under About.
Add only the listed setup materials that every teammate may use, then send the first message to the Team Bot.
Keep the Bot a Draft while you compare one triage result and reply draft with its source records.

blanks.name: [SUPPORT_APP]
blanks.what: Connected support app approved for shared use.

blanks.name: [SUPPORT_SCOPE]
blanks.what: The queue or subset of support requests this Bot may read.

blanks.name: [SUPPORT_RULES]
blanks.what: Current support rules, including priority and escalation criteria.

blanks.name: [SHARED_SKILLS]
blanks.what: Support skills intended for every teammate using this Bot, or none.

blanks.name: [SHARED_FILES]
blanks.what: Support reference files intended for every teammate using this Bot.

items.title: Build a deep link with an unsent message
items.title_ja: 未送信の文面を開くディープリンクの作成
items.does: Guides you through a Bot id, short message, URL encoding and an opening check. Stops with the message unsent and the link unpublished.
items.does_ja: BotのID、短い文面、URLエンコード、開いた画面の確認を順に進めます。文面は送信せず、リンクも公開する前で止めます。
stops: Before sending the prepared message or publishing the link: leave both for a separate decision.
Before purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production: this checklist only prepares a message.
When the Bot id is unknown or the opened Bot differs: stop and obtain the intended id.
When the message contains secrets, exceeds the chosen length or appears altered: correct it before use.
When the message box already contains text: preserve it and postpone the opening check.
first3: Fill the blanks: the Bot's id and a harmless message.
Find the id: open the Bot's name, choose Share, then Copy link. The id is the last part.
Review the message for secrets and keep it below 1,000 characters before encoding.

blanks.name: [BOT_ID]
blanks.what: The actual id of the Bot that should open; do not substitute its display name.

blanks.name: [MESSAGE]
blanks.what: The message to prepare, under 1,000 characters and containing no secrets.

items.title: Check a Bot before sharing
items.title_ja: Botを共有する前の点検
items.does: Checks a Bot’s sharing material and team access for private information. Stops before sharing, publishing, sending, payment, deletion or production changes.
items.does_ja: Botの共有用の内容とチームのアクセス範囲に、非公開情報が含まれていないか点検します。共有・公開・送信・支払い・削除・本番環境の変更の前で止まります。
stops: Before sharing or publishing the Bot: keep the reviewed material private.
Before sending, purchasing, paying, deleting anything or changing production.
When an app, file or account exposes information outside the intended audience.
When the audience is unclear, or a finding is still open: keep a Team Bot as a Draft.
first3: Fill in the Bot and intended audience before reviewing any sharing material.
Inspect the identity and description for private details, using About for a Team Bot.
Work through the skills, routines, apps and files before making any sharing decision.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The Bot whose sharing material you will review.

blanks.name: [AUDIENCE]
blanks.what: The intended audience: public users or a defined team group.

items.title: Check a first message before you send it
items.title_ja: 最初のメッセージを送る前の点検
items.does: A checklist for the first message to a new Bot: one job, sources, rules to remember, approval boundaries, no secrets. Stops before the message is sent; nothing is sent, published, paid for or deleted.
items.does_ja: 新しいBotへの最初のメッセージを点検する手順です。仕事が1つに絞られているか、参照元・覚えておく決まり・事前の承認が必要な操作が書かれているか、秘密情報が入っていないかを確認します。メッセージを送る前で止まり、送信・公開・支払い・削除は行いません。
stops: Before sending the first message: the checklist ends with the text still unsent.
Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting anything or changing production through the Bot.
When the text holds a password, card number or API key: remove it and stop until it is gone.
When the job cannot be said in one sentence: split it before going on.
first3: Write the Bot name and its one job into the two blanks.
Read your draft first message against steps 2 to 9, one step at a time.
Stop at step 12 with the message still unsent, and decide yourself whether to send it.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The name of the new Bot the message is for.

blanks.name: [JOB]
blanks.what: The one job this Bot will have, in one sentence.

items.title: Check a Team Bot draft before Publish
items.title_ja: Team Bot を Publish する前の点検
items.does: A checklist for a Team Bot that is still a Draft: the About description, plugins, apps, secrets, skills, files and roles. Stops before Publish; nothing is published, paid for or deleted.
items.does_ja: まだ Draft の Team Bot を点検する手順です。About の説明、プラグイン、アプリ、シークレット、スキル、ファイル、役割を見ます。Publish の前で止まります。公開・支払い・削除は行わず、このBotとのチャット以外への送信もしません。
stops: Before pressing Publish: the checklist ends with the Team Bot still a Draft.
Before sending, purchasing, paying, deleting anything or changing production.
When a shared app or secret reaches data the whole audience should not see: remove it and stop until it is gone.
When nobody is named to review what teammates teach the Bot: keep it a Draft.
first3: Write the Team Bot name and the people who will use it into the two blanks.
Open the Bot's details and go through About, Plugins, Secrets, Skills and Files in that order.
Stop at step 12 with the Bot still a Draft, and decide yourself whether to publish.

blanks.name: [TEAM_BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The Team Bot draft you are checking.

blanks.name: [AUDIENCE]
blanks.what: The teammates who will be able to chat with it.

items.title: Check a webhook routine before use
items.title_ja: Webhookルーティンを使う前の確認
items.does: Walks through a safe webhook request and its run result. Stops before downstream messages, publishing, payments, deletion or production changes.
items.does_ja: 安全な内容でWebhookを呼び出し、実行結果を確認する手順です。後続のメッセージ送信、公開、支払い、削除、本番環境の変更の前で止めます。
stops: Before sending messages, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production: the routine must stop for approval.
When the endpoint, key or safe input is missing: do not send the test request.
After a response other than 200: no run started. Read the response before any second call.
When the key may have leaked: stop using it and choose a recovery plan before further calls.
first3: Fill the routine name and a harmless payload containing no private data.
Open that routine on desktop and locate its Webhook section.
Read its approval boundary before preparing a request; a webhook starts real work.

blanks.name: [ROUTINE_NAME]
blanks.what: The routine whose webhook you want to check.

blanks.name: [SAFE_PAYLOAD]
blanks.what: Harmless test input with no secrets or private data.

items.title: Move old Description text into chat
items.title_ja: 以前の Description の文面をチャットへ移す
items.does: For people who kept instructions in a personal Bot's Description: say the same rules in chat, ask the Bot to remember them, check what it kept. Sends nothing outside the Bot's chat; publishes and deletes nothing.
items.does_ja: 個人のBotの Description に指示を入れていた人向けの手順です。同じ決まりをチャットで伝え、覚えておくよう頼み、何を覚えたかを確かめます。このBotとのチャット以外への送信はせず、公開・支払い・削除も行いません。
stops: Before the Bot acts on the moved text: the checklist only sets rules and asks what the Bot kept.
Before sending anything outside the Bot's chat, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production.
When the old text holds a login, card number or API key: leave it out. Logins and card numbers go in Vault; API keys go through a secure secret card.
When the Bot's answer differs from your text: correct it before giving the Bot any work.
first3: Write the Bot name and paste your old text into the two blanks.
Split the old text into the job, the lasting rules and everything else, as in steps 3 to 5.
Send the job and the rules in chat, ask the Bot to remember them, then ask what it kept and check the answer.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The personal Bot whose instructions used to sit in a Description.

blanks.name: [OLD_TEXT]
blanks.what: The text you used to keep there, from your own copy.

items.title: Plan a routine usage budget
items.title_ja: ルーティンの実行回数を見積もる
items.does: Estimates scheduled and event-driven runs against documented limits. Stops before increasing activity with unknown counts or allowing sending, publishing, payments, deletion or production changes.
items.does_ja: 定期実行とイベント起動の回数を、公開されている上限と照らし合わせる手順です。回数が不明なまま実行を増やすことや、送信・公開・支払い・削除・本番変更の前で止まります。
stops: Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production: budgeting does not authorize those actions.
When counts are unknown or near a limit: keep the frequency unchanged until the missing counts are available.
When schedules are less than five minutes apart or a Bot would exceed 50 routines: revise the plan.
When estimated traffic exceeds 300 runs per hour overall or 200 for one routine: reduce the planned activity.
When a run fails: inspect the result before a manual retry; failed runs are not retried automatically.
first3: Fill the blanks with your own counts and list the owning Bot's routines.
Calculate the scheduled runs in the busiest hour across all Bots.
Count matching new events during a busy hour instead of using an average.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The Bot whose routine plan you are reviewing.

blanks.name: [SCHEDULE_MINUTES]
blanks.what: Each regular schedule's interval in minutes; use its own value for each schedule, at least five.

blanks.name: [SCHEDULED_RUNS_PER_HOUR]
blanks.what: Scheduled runs across all Bots during the busiest planned hour.

blanks.name: [PEAK_EVENTS_PER_HOUR]
blanks.what: Expected event-triggered runs across all routines during a busy hour, counting each matching routine.

blanks.name: [WEEKLY_RUN_BUDGET]
blanks.what: Your own weekly run-count target; this is not a product usage allowance.

items.title: Review a skill learned from a demonstration
items.title_ja: 実演から作られたスキルの点検
items.does: Turns a demonstrated workflow draft into instructions with decision rules, failure handling and a safe example. Stops before sending, publishing, payment, deletion or production changes.
items.does_ja: 実演から作られた下書きに、判断基準・失敗時の対応・安全な例を加える手順です。送信・公開・支払い・削除・本番環境の変更の前で止まります。
stops: Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production.
When the demonstration would expose credentials: use Vault or a secure secret card outside the recording.
When a required source is missing, stale or unreadable: leave a visible gap.
When the safe example fails or a site change alters the workflow: revise the draft before further use.
first3: Fill the blanks, starting with the result you expect from one safe example.
Open the learned draft and compare its steps with the demonstrated workflow.
Add the decision rules, failure handling and approval boundary before a safe trial.

blanks.name: [SKILL_NAME]
blanks.what: The name of the skill draft learned from the demonstration.

blanks.name: [EXPECTED_RESULT]
blanks.what: The observable result and the details you will compare.

blanks.name: [INPUT_SOURCE]
blanks.what: The permitted source and access needed for the task.

blanks.name: [SAFE_EXAMPLE]
blanks.what: A non-sensitive example that cannot cause external actions.

items.title: Review your Custom Rules
items.title_ja: Custom Rules の見直し
items.does: A checklist for reading every "Ask first" and "Allow automatically" rule, finding overlaps and gaps, and writing proposed changes. Stops before any rule is changed; nothing is sent, published, paid for or deleted.
items.does_ja: 「Ask first」と「Allow automatically」のルールをすべて読み、重なりと抜けを見つけて変更案を書く手順です。ルールを変える前で止まり、送信・公開・支払い・削除は行いません。
stops: Before adding, editing or deleting a rule: the checklist ends with a written proposal only.
Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting anything or changing production.
When an "Allow automatically" rule covers sending, paying, deleting or production: mark it for removal and stop relying on it.
When you cannot say what a rule matches: mark it unclear instead of keeping it as it is.
first3: Write the actions you never want done without you, and the ones you are content to allow, into the two blanks.
Open Custom Rules and copy both lists into a note before judging anything.
Stop at step 12 with a written proposal, and change the rules yourself afterwards.

blanks.name: [ASK_FIRST_ACTIONS]
blanks.what: The actions that must always wait for you, in your own words.

blanks.name: [ALLOWED_ACTIONS]
blanks.what: The narrow, harmless actions you are content to allow without a card.

items.title: Routine preflight before it runs alone
items.title_ja: ルーティンを動かす前の確認
items.does: Checks a routine before a safe Test and resuming scheduled work. Stops on unresolved checks or any action that would send, publish, pay, delete or change production.
items.does_ja: 安全な入力での Test と定期実行の再開に向け、設定を確認する手順です。確認できない点や、送信・公開・支払い・削除・本番変更につながる処理があれば止まります。
stops: Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting or changing production: keep those actions outside the test.
When the owner, timing, input or result location is unclear: leave the routine paused.
When missing or stale sources have no handling rule: revise the request before Test.
When a background approval card expires after 30 minutes: record the action as not done.
When Test fails or only partly finishes: read what was covered before deciding on another test.
first3: Fill the blanks and open the owning Bot's Details to find the routine.
Read "When to run", the time zone and the approval boundary against what you asked for.
Press Test once with the safe input and read what the run did.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The Bot that should own this routine.

blanks.name: [ROUTINE_NAME]
blanks.what: The routine to inspect before resuming it.

blanks.name: [SAFE_INPUT]
blanks.what: A small, non-sensitive input that needs no external action.

items.title: See and correct what a Bot remembers
items.title_ja: Botが覚えていることの確認と訂正
items.does: Ask a Bot what it remembers on one topic, then correct or remove entries one at a time. Nothing is forgotten without your decision; nothing is sent, published, paid for or deleted elsewhere.
items.does_ja: あるテーマについてBotが何を覚えているかを尋ね、1件ずつ訂正または削除する手順です。あなたが決める前に記憶を消すことはしません。外部への送信・公開・支払い・削除も行いません。
stops: Before asking the Bot to forget anything: decide entry by entry, never in bulk.
Before sending, publishing, purchasing, paying, deleting files or changing production: this checklist touches memory only.
When a remembered item is a login, card number or API key: stop and ask the Bot to forget it. Logins and card numbers go in Vault; API keys go through a secure secret card.
When the Bot cannot say where an item came from: mark it unverified instead of approving it.
first3: Write the Bot name and the topic into the two blanks.
Ask the question in step 2 and copy the answer somewhere you can mark up.
Mark each remembered item keep, correct or forget before you ask for any change.

blanks.name: [BOT_NAME]
blanks.what: The Bot whose memory you are checking.

blanks.name: [TOPIC]
blanks.what: The topic to ask about, such as a project, a vendor or your working hours.
